title: Red-cell dispersion–volume interaction: uncertain incremental prediction of C-reactive protein across NHANES cycles
abstract: In exploratory transfer from NHANES 2007–2008 (n=4,850) to 2009–2010 (n=5,230), an RDW-by-MCV interaction reduced weighted log-CRP MSE by 0.005457 (0.48%), but joint source/target PSU-bootstrap uncertainty included no gain (added-minus-baseline MSE 95% interval -0.011052 to 0.005822). Reliable incremental predictive value was not established.
